arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, glob, urllib.request, urllib.parse, os
ws_file=sorted(glob.glob('/tmp/drive_vm_ws_flutter_run_nothingness_opus_shuffle_eval_*.txt'))[-1]
ws_url=open(ws_file).read().strip(); base=ws_url.replace('ws://','http://'); base=base[:-3]
vm=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(f"{base}/getVM").read().decode()); main=next(i for i in vm['result']['isolates'] if i['name']=='main'); isolate_param=f"isolates/{main['id']}"

def ext(method, **params):
    q={'isolateId':isolate_param, **{k:v for k,v in params.items() if v is not None}}
    url=f"{base}/ext.nothingness.{method}?"+urllib.parse.urlencode(q)
    data=urllib.request.urlopen(url).read().decode();
    return json.loads(data)

fixtures=sorted(glob.glob('/opt/nothingness/media/*.opus')); fixtures=sorted(fixtures,key=lambda p: os.path.basename(p))
print('setQueue response', ext('setQueue', paths=','.join(fixtures), startIndex='0'))
st=ext('getPlaybackState'); print('state keys',st.keys()); print(json.dumps(st,indent=2)[:1200])
PY
